task: Write the meta description of a Korean blog post from its title and the first paragraph of its introduction.
constraints: source: Use only what inputs.title and inputs.first_paragraph say. Add no claims, numbers, or promises that are not there.
shape: One or two Korean sentences, at most 150 characters in total, in 합쇼체 (~습니다) like the first paragraph.
content: Say what the post covers and the point it makes. Do not open with '이 글은' or '이 글에서는'.

summary.description: Korean meta description, at most 150 characters
